Welcome to MMHVAULT

Let’s get your personal wealth workspace ready.

1. Your account is ready

Your Customer ID is created automatically and your account stays connected to your own cloud data.

✓ Secure sign-in with Google, Phone OTP or Email / Password
✓ Personal Customer ID such as MF0001
✓ Your finance records remain separated by account

2. Add your first transaction

Start with one income or expense. MMHVAULT will automatically use it across Dashboard, Analyze and Cash Flow.

💵 Income — salary, bonus or other income
💳 Expense — dining, transport, lifestyle and more
📊 Analyze updates automatically

3. You’re ready to go

You can add investments, update exchange rates, review your financial health and manage backups from MMHVAULT.

📈 Track Crypto & Gold investments

Rates
—
Restore never replaces your Customer ID or authentication. Existing transactions and investments are preserved; only missing records are added. Saved exchange rates are applied after confirmation, and missing Account / Category settings are merged without overwriting your current setup.
Backups are downloaded to your device as a JSON file. They include Transactions, Investments, Exchange Rates and your Account / Category configuration. Restore adds missing finance records and merges missing configuration into the signed-in account. Your Customer ID and Supabase authentication are never replaced by a backup.
